name: glyph
description: A shorthand command notation that compiles to structured XML. The AST is the source of truth; the XML is a projection of it.

scripts.check: node scripts/build-templates.js --check && node scripts/build-skill.js --check && node scripts/check-globals.js && node scripts/dag.js && node scripts/test-corpus.js

note: `type: module` exists so the core can be split into files the browser can load without a bundler — see .guidelines/HGML_PLAN.md D1, open since v1.1. There are no `dependencies` and there never will be: zero-dependency is a property of this repository, not an accident of it. This file adds scripts and a module system, nothing else.
